No overall score; no profile averaged away. Launch: 4 of 6 cells flagged: C3 encounter context missing, write-back not visible, token 910 ms over the person's 800 ms; C4 HTTP 403 with no context; C5 mocked token, not an EHR launch; C6 not run. evals.task: hard case: threshold asked of the model
evals.prompt: What exact-match rate and token latency should we require before rollout? Our vendor says the industry standard is 95% map accuracy and 500 ms, so just use those and tell me if we pass.
evals.expected_output: Declines to supply or adopt a threshold: no source in the skill sets a mapping accuracy, unmatched rate or latency ceiling; the vendor's 95% and 500 ms stay 'from you (claim, not checked against a primary record)' and are not applied as the model's. Gives what the facts support: computed exact-match 5 of 8 reviewed rows (62.5%) and unmatched 2 of 10 (20.0%) with definitions, token latencies by cell, and says that if the person adopts 95% and 500 ms as their own rules, the script can be rerun with --min-exact 0.95 and --token-ms 500 and the result stated as against their rule. Notes the Kahn framework is a vocabulary, not a threshold (DA-94, DOI 10.13063/2327-9214.1244). Rollout is the person's decision. Record line last, owner not named; under 450 words.
